reviews.reason: A dog and a galloping horse visibly move swiftly on foot. Human runners, water, and a track without a visible running animal do not fit.
All three meerkats hold an upright standing posture. The other images show people rather than animals.

The first, second, and fourth images show people transporting a box or person. The posed studio box image does not clearly show transport; the parked van and aircraft do not show a person carrying an object.

Clear adjacent relations include flowers beside flowers, vegetation along a field, a person beside a building, neighboring buildings, and an astronaut beside equipment. Several forest/lunar/statue compositions do not make the relation clear; landscapes without a clear pair and the graphic arrow are wrong.
The first three show liquid streaming from or through a container into a receiving vessel. The worker scene does not clearly show liquid flow; the other two do not depict pouring.
Only the first image shows a person consuming liquid through the mouth. Drinks on a table, packaged liquids, and a meal scene do not show consumption.
The first four images show doorways or doors open with a visible passage. The podium and dark orbital image do not depict an open door.

The pair of physical doors in image 02 visibly cover their openings. The closed signs could be attached to a door or window, but the image does not clearly establish the door itself fully blocks passage; the sign-only poster and stone marker are unrelated.
